segments.name: Solar energy optimization solutions
segments.description: Designs, develops and sells solar energy optimization solutions, including module-level power electronics, energy storage systems and energy management services, to installers and end users.
segments.evidence: The Company has one business activity — the design, development and sale of solar energy optimization solutions.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue primarily from selling its MLPE products, GO ESS and other offerings to installers, distributors and customers in residential and commercial and industrial markets.
revenueModel.evidence: Although a significant portion of our revenue is derived from our MLPE products, we are continuing to develop and promote additional offerings such as our GO ESS product line and Predict+ service, which we believe will help contribute to long-term revenue growth and market leadership.
